versions.changelog:
- Adds calendar support: read, search, and manage Outlook/Microsoft 365 calendar alongside email.
- Updated description to reflect mail and calendar coverage; notes CLI as a secure Outlook firewall alternative.
- Expanded safety section to include calendar mutation safeguards and notifications guidance.
- New commands for listing, searching, creating, updating, deleting, and responding to calendar events.
- Improved metadata with detailed install steps and environment variable explanations.
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md for streamlining.

Skill description update.

- No updates to commands, features, or documentation.
- Functionality and instructions remain unchanged.

- Skill renamed from "outlook-porteden" to "outlook-cli".
- Description updated to highlight Outlook Management.
- No functional or command changes; documentation and naming only.

Outlook integration skill initial release.

- Secure CLI for reading, searching, and triaging Outlook/Microsoft 365 email with strong privacy and confirmation safeguards.
- Mutating actions (send, reply, forward, delete, modify) require explicit user confirmation with full context before proceeding.
- Supports detailed email search, filtering, sending, replying, forwarding, category management, and deletion from the command line.
- Browser-based, token-based, and environment variable authentication supported; credentials stored in system keyring.
- Safety-first: minimizes scope, treats email content as untrusted, promotes least-privilege and easy revocation.
